item.title: Nana Patekar's late-night message & what doctors revealed about hours that followed
item.description: Actor Nana Patekar was declared dead after being brought to Manipal Hospital in Goa. He sent a message to a friend indicating he was unwell before losing consciousness. Friends and a caretaker accompanied him when he was taken to the hospital. Medical staff attempted to revive him for nearly an hour but declared him dead upon arrival. His body has been sent for a post-mortem examination following a medico-legal case.
item.dc:creator: NIDA SAYED

item.title: Nana Patekar to be accorded state funeral; last rites at Pune farmhouse
item.description: Nana Patekar has passed away at his residence in Goa at the age of 75. He made significant contributions to both Hindi and Marathi cinema over several decades. Patekar was known for his powerful performances and distinctive screen presence in numerous films. Throughout his career, he received multiple National Awards and a Padma Shri for his work in the arts.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: ‘Baseless, misconceived’: Govt rejects Musk’s ‘oligarch’ claim over Starlink block
item.dc:creator: SAURABH SINHA

item.title: ‘Like a Parinda, he soared’: PM Modi remembers ‘Krantiveer’ Nana Patekar
item.dc:creator: ABHISHEK MISHRA

item.title: ‘So many have faded out’: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi cautioned with Vinod Kambli example
item.description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is making waves in the cricket world with his remarkable feats at an early age. However, cricket legend Kapil Dev advocates caution, emphasizing the volatile nature of youth talent. He stresses the significance of a player's growth beyond the cricket field for long-term success. In essence, the key question remains whether Sooryavanshi can sustain his performance consistently over the years.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.title: A billionaire's Amazon celebration becomes a scandal in Austria, reaches Parliament
item.description: Haidlmair recently celebrated its largest Amazon order with an elaborate party in Upper Austria. A Bezos impersonator arrived via helicopter, accompanied by actual police officers. The involvement of a special police unit has sparked controversy regarding their presence at the event. Reports indicate that the police may have been compensated for their time during this unusual assignment.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.dc:creator: KANCHAN YADAV

item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: BJP turns heat on Rahul Gandhi over 'clash' with female Delhi cop
item.description: BJP leaders escalated attacks on Rahul Gandhi following his protests against the Election Commission. C R Kesavan accused Gandhi of inappropriate behavior toward a female police officer during the protest. Nitin Nabin labeled Gandhi as having an anarchist mindset and suggested he resign if he disagrees with the Election Commission. The Congress party has expressed demands for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over recent decisions.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: US-based woman files case against parents for property share; Karnataka HC rejects it
item.description: The case involves a dispute over whether properties that had come to the woman’s father from her grandfather retained the character of ancestral property, giving her a right to seek partition under the Hindu Succession Act. The woman, based in the US, has been living abroad since her marriage in 1979. She filed a suit seeking partition of family properties and an equal share in them after her father sold one property.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: Nova Scotia man's 1975 wallet found after 51 years under floorboards intact
item.description: Lost wallet from 1975 found 51 years later with birth certificate, $1 and Hamlet ticket inside
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Lake Minnetonka estate bought for $3.45M in 2013 now sells for $18.25M, sets record
item.description: An exceptional estate on Lake Minnetonka in Deephaven has achieved a remarkable milestone by selling for $18.25 million. Nestled at 20670 Linwood Road, this stunning property covers roughly 2.39 acres and features 350 feet of pristine shoreline. Crafted by the talented Charles Stinson, the modern home offers an expansive 10,440 square feet complete with five luxurious bedrooms and nine upscale bathrooms, breaking the previous record of $17.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Priscilla Chan founded a school; 10 years later, Board votes to close it
item.description: Priscilla Chan's vision of a tuition-free educational environment for low-income families faced closure after a decade of significant funding. As the board made the difficult decision to shut down due to certain funding withdrawal, students found themselves with mixed academic results, some even excelling in literacy. With 540 students affected, the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative has stepped in to provide financial aid to families and local organizations in the aftermath.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Sandra Bullock’s 91-acre California ranch with 1,200 avocado trees sells for $5.6M
item.description: In 2007, Sandra Bullock acquired a sprawling 91-acre ranch in Valley Center for $2.725 million. After transforming it with extensive renovations and establishing an organic avocado farm, she sold the property for $5.6 million in 2024. Encompassing a beautifully refurbished adobe house, a guest cottage, and facilities for agricultural operations, the ranch stands as a perfect blend of luxury and sustainability for its future owner.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi booked over 'assault' during anti-Gyanesh protest in Delhi
item.dc:creator: KANCHAN YADAV

item.dc:creator: ABHISHEK MISHRA

item.title: 'Who knows about tomorrow': Nana Patekar's words at last public appearance
item.description: Nana Patekar died from a cardiac arrest shortly after an event in Goa, where he emphasized life's uncertainties. He encouraged attendees to serve others and live fully, stating that nothing is taken after death. Patekar was a prominent figure in theatre and cinema, recognized for his impactful performances in Hindi and Marathi films. Following his death, tributes poured in from across the country, highlighting his contributions to the arts.
item.dc:creator: NIDA SAYED

item.title: ‘Play more cricket’: Kapil Dev’s blunt take on Hardik Pandya’s injury woes
item.description: Hardik Pandya's long absence from competitive cricket emphasizes ongoing concerns regarding player workload and fitness issues. Despite working towards a return, his recurring shin issue has delayed his comeback plans. Other players, including Prasidh Krishna and Harshit Rana, are also facing injury challenges affecting their participation. Former captain Kapil Dev pointed out the importance of playing regularly to maintain fitness levels.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.title: ‘Last warning’: Houthis tell airlines to avoid Saudi airspace, spare Mecca, Medina
item.dc:creator: AASTHA JHA

item.title: How Shashi Tharoor left CJP's Saurav Das without a sting in the tail
item.description: Saurav Das attempted to draw Shashi Tharoor into discussing Prime Minister Narendra Modi's recent temple visit. Tharoor responded ambiguously, requesting clarification regarding the controversial metaphor he previously used. This interaction occurred against a backdrop of political tensions surrounding electoral roll revisions in Delhi. Opposition leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, were detained while protesting.
item.dc:creator: HADI KHAN

item.title: 'No excuse for victim blaming': Mamdani under fire from Democrats over Oct 7 message
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: Florida mom rides 7,000 miles across 48 states, donates $17,560 to family support home
item.description: A Florida woman completed a 7,000-mile motorcycle journey across 48 states in six days. She raised $17,560 for Quantum House, an organization that supported her during her daughter’s hospital stay. The ride attracted attention, allowing her to create awareness about the organization. Jess's daughter, who benefitted from Quantum House, joined her when she presented the raised funds.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: What is ‘enemy property’ and how is it identified? Allahabad high court explains
item.description: The Allahabad High Court made significant rulings on a property conflict in Muzaffarnagar concerning enemy and evacuee claims. The court determined that the state lacked substantial evidence to support its claims and highlighted the dismissal of prior complaints regarding the property. Consequently, it prohibited state officials from halting construction based on the approved map, thereby safeguarding the petitioners' property rights and ability to build.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH THAKUR

item.title: 'If Shami is neglected, door will be closed': Ex-India star warns selectors
item.description: Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s return to the Indian team after a four-year gap has raised the possibility of another experienced pacer making his way back into the squad. Former India batter Wasim Jaffer believes Mohammed Shami deserves that opportunity, particularly in Test cricket. Shami has produced strong performances since returning from a long injury lay-off and has remained among the wickets across formats.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: President Murmu, PM Modi hail IAF on Air Force Day
item.description: On October 8, the Indian Air Force marked its 94th anniversary, showcasing the unwavering commitment of its air warriors. In a ceremonial salute, President Droupadi Murmu and Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to their bravery and expertise that ensure the safety of the nation. Since its inception, the IAF has progressed notably, enhancing its strategic capabilities and modernizing its aircraft.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Rupee rises 10 paise against US dollar: What is supporting the currency?
item.description: The rupee opened at 96.71 against the dollar but improved to 96.65 thanks to intervention from the Reserve Bank of India. External factors, like a robust US dollar and climbing crude oil prices, are still putting pressure on the currency. Additionally, India's forex reserves are diminishing, leading to unease about the rupee's consistency.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: Pakistan's terror monsters now wreak havoc in its own backyard: India at UN
item.dc:creator: ABHISHEK MISHRA

item.title: Syria considers sending troops to Saudi Arabia to fight Houthis
item.description: Syria is considering military support for Saudi Arabia amid increased Houthi attacks on the kingdom. Discussions include potentially deploying troops as well as providing defensive expertise to combat the Houthi threat. Recent years have seen a strengthening of relations between Syria and Saudi Arabia, with new economic agreements established. However, Syria's priority remains its own recovery from a prolonged civil war.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: ‘Cracks after quake’: Pregnant woman, 2 kids dead in Delhi building collapse
item.description: Three individuals, including two children, lost their lives when a building collapsed in Seemapuri, Delhi. Rescue teams responded promptly to the scene, searching for survivors and assisting the injured. Local residents reported that the structure had developed cracks after an earthquake a day earlier. The building reportedly belonged to the Delhi Urban Shelter Improvement Board and was around 20-25 years old.
item.dc:creator: G S DHANUSH

item.title: Man beheads minor girlfriend in forest, dies in crash while fleeing
item.description: A 17-year-old girl was reported missing and found murdered in a forest in Madhya Pradesh. Ankit Malviya, her boyfriend, allegedly killed her after an argument, using a saw. He later called his cousin to confess before attempting suicide and colliding with a truck. Police discovered the girl's body and a saw at the scene, along with a rope noose.
item.dc:creator: P NAVEEN

item.title: 'Unko select karke koi meherbani nahi ki': Wasim on Bhuvneshwar's India return
item.description: Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s return to India’s T20I squad has received strong backing from former India batter Wasim Jaffer, who believes the experienced pacer’s selection is based on his performances and fitness, rather than any favour. Bhuvneshwar, 36, has been recalled for India’s five-match T20I series against New Zealand, beginning October 22. Jaffer feels the veteran seamer should have been brought back into the national setup earlier.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: Some oligarchs blocking entry of Starlink in India: Elon Musk
item.description: Elon Musk has claimed that certain oligarchs are obstructing Starlink's entry into the Indian market. Starlink has already established the necessary infrastructure and is prepared to launch its services. The company aims to provide affordable broadband connectivity to areas lacking internet access. Regulatory approvals are awaited before the commercial rollout can commence in India. Collaboration with local telecom operators has been a key element in Starlink's strategy for success.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH SINHA

item.title: 'Stabbed 7 times': How bid to seal petrol pump turned deadly for IndianOil official
item.description: In a tragic incident, Mahesh Shelke, the sales manager for IndianOil, was fatally stabbed during an altercation at a petrol pump as he sought to take control of the outlet amid a dispute. Swift action was taken by authorities, resulting in the arrest of five individuals, including members of the Pandavveer family. IndianOil and the petroleum ministry have rallied to support Shelke's family during this devastating period.
item.dc:creator: MOHAMMED AKHEF

item.title: US to strike Iran? Pentagon orders military to gear up for attacks
item.description: The Pentagon has been instructed to prepare for possible military actions against Iran, amid stalled diplomatic efforts. Preparations may lead to attacks on Iranian nuclear facilities and strategic sites, although no attack timeline has been set. This situation overlaps with renewed fighting in Yemen, where Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia have intensified. Meanwhile, elections in the US and Israel may influence military decisions in the region.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Delhi Police likely to file FIR over alleged assault on police during Congress protest
item.description: Delhi Police is reviewing videos to identify protesters involved in the alleged assault during a Congress protest. Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi were detained for defying police orders while attempting to proceed to Jantar Mantar. Police are also taking action against misleading social media posts regarding their conduct during the protest. Earlier, an FIR was lodged against Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi for forcibly entering Akashvani Bhawan.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Texas carries out first US execution since Christa Pike's botched lethal injection
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: 'Naman Dhir has finished him': World Cup winner's big statement on star's T20I future
item.description: Naman Dhir had scored 318 runs in IPL 2026 but did not bowl a single over during the tournament. His international debut showed that he can offer India another option with the ball. Former India cricketer and 1983 World Cup winner Krishnamachari Srikkanth believes Dhir’s emergence could seriously hurt Washington Sundar’s chances in white-ball cricket.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: IIT-B puts on hold 2026 rules on tough penalties for cheating
item.description: IIT-Bombay’s senate has halted new penalties for academic misconduct, reverting to the 2015 policy for upcoming examinations. This decision follows the recent death of a student suspected of cheating during an exam. An interim procedure allows faculty to document suspected dishonesty while encouraging student accounts on a separate form. Faculty members and students will present their cases before a disciplinary committee after the examination period.
item.dc:creator: HEMALI CHHAPIA

item.title: Oil remains beyond $100 per barrel as Middle East supply concerns persist
item.description: As tensions escalate in the Middle East, particularly around the Strait of Hormuz, oil prices have surged amid fears of potential supply disruptions. Recent assaults on tankers heighten the danger of transporting crude through this vital corridor. Additionally, American crude inventories are dwindling, signaling a tighter market, while diesel and jet fuel stocks remain below average levels, a trend seen for over seven months since the onset of regional conflict.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: Russia rejects second plague scare as WHO demands answers over Siberian lab deaths
item.description: In response to concerns over a second suspected plague case linked to a worker's death, Russia has denied these allegations. The World Health Organization is looking for more details on the illness that led to the worker's pneumonia. Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov denounced many media reports as false. Health officials assure the public that there is no epidemic threat while WHO seeks more information to evaluate health risks.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: 'We'll do it': PM Modi gives slogan for 2047 goals
item.description: PM Narendra Modi delivered a speech highlighting his 25 years in government and the goal of developed India by 2047. He called upon citizens to commit to this ambitious target and emphasized the power of the people. Modi reiterated the importance of extraordinary goals, linking good governance to societal inclusion. He reflected on his journey from humble beginnings to leadership in the BJP.
item.dc:creator: KUMAR RAKESH

item.title: 'Satisfied with my runs': Pakistan batter opens up on Asian Games final loss to India
item.description: India beat Pakistan by 19 runs to win the men’s cricket gold medal at the Asian Games last week.
item.dc:creator: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI

item.title: India's diabetes burden is creating another problem: The growing threat to eyesight
item.description: Diabetic retinopathy often progresses quietly, leading to significant eye damage before symptoms are detected. Therefore, routine eye exams are imperative for early identification, even if one's vision appears normal. Studies show a strong link between how long a person has diabetes and their risk of developing vision issues. Consistently managing blood sugar levels and health can help avert major vision loss.
item.dc:creator: MAITREE BARAL

item.title: 'Fight goes on’: 87-yr-old woman dies after becoming symbol of Spain housing crisis
item.description: María del Carmen Abascal, known as Maricarmen, died in a hospital after being evicted from her home. Her eviction triggered nationwide protests highlighting the housing crisis afflicting Spain. Activists voiced anger over Maricarmen's death as a symbol of the struggle against rising rents and evictions. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez offered condolences, acknowledging the impact of her case on public sentiment.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA
